products.name: Strength for Today Sweatshirt
products.short_description:
A hymn line worth carrying. The Strength for Today Sweatshirt has a small Celtic Worship wordmark on the chest and “strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow” printed across the back.

  • Unisex crew-neck fit — sizes S to XL
  • Soft cream colourway
  • Shipped from Scotland, worldwide delivery available
products.description:
The Strength for Today Sweatshirt is a quieter piece of Celtic Worship merchandise: a small wordmark on the chest, and across the back, a line that many people already carry with them — “strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow”, from the hymn Great Is Thy Faithfulness. It is set in a warm retro display type on a soft cream crew-neck.

About the Strength for Today Sweatshirt

Celtic Worship are a Scottish collective who set much-loved hymns and new worship songs in a Celtic idiom, with fiddle, whistle, guitar and close harmony at the heart of the arrangements. Great Is Thy Faithfulness has long been part of their live set, and this sweatshirt lifts one line from it. It is designed to be worn every day rather than kept for gigs, and every order supports the band directly.

Features

  • Official Celtic Worship merchandise
  • Small Celtic Worship wordmark printed on the front chest
  • Hymn lyric printed large across the back in a retro display type
  • Classic unisex crew-neck cut with ribbed cuffs and hem
  • One colourway: soft cream
  • Four sizes: S, M, L and XL
  • Packed and posted from Scotland, with worldwide delivery available

Materials

Fabric composition, fabric weight (GSM), interior finish and print method for the Strength for Today Sweatshirt are all to be confirmed. We are waiting on the final specification sheet from our garment supplier and will publish exact details here before launch. If you need the information sooner, please get in touch.

Size Information

The Strength for Today Sweatshirt is available in S, M, L and XL in a unisex fit. A measurement chart giving chest width, body length and sleeve length for each size is to be confirmed and will be added here as a size guide. Cream garments are often worn a size up for a relaxed look; we will confirm the true-to-size guidance once we have the supplier chart.

Care Instructions

Cream fabrics reward a little care. We recommend washing inside out at 30°C on a gentle cycle with other light colours, avoiding bleach and fabric conditioner, drying flat and away from direct sunlight rather than tumble drying, and ironing on the reverse only — never directly over the back print. The manufacturer’s care label always takes precedence; the exact label wording is to be confirmed.

Weight and Dimensions

The weight currently recorded against this product is 0.465 kg. That figure has not yet been verified on scales, and the packed parcel dimensions are to be confirmed. Both will be measured before launch so that postage is charged accurately.

Shipping

Shipping is calculated automatically at checkout from total parcel weight and delivery country. We currently post to the UK, much of Europe, the USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Japan. Dispatch and delivery timescales are to be confirmed. Orders travelling outside the UK may attract local import VAT, customs duty or a carrier handling fee; where these apply they are payable by the recipient and are not included in the price shown here.

Returns

Full returns, exchange and cancellation details will be published on our returns page — the policy wording is to be confirmed. If your sweatshirt arrives faulty, damaged or not what you ordered, contact us and we will put it right.

More from Celtic Worship

If you like the Strength for Today Sweatshirt, have a look at the Harvest range: the Harvest Sweatshirt, the Harvest T-Shirt and the Harvest Tote Bag. You can also pick up the albums on CD and vinyl, or browse everything in the Celtic Worship store.

products.description:
Sheet music for Where Can I Go, from the album Harvest.

About our sheet music

Over the years we have had quite a few requests for sheet music for our songs, which we were sadly never able to fulfil — we always arrange collaboratively and almost never write anything down. We have now started the process of writing songs down in a format we hope everyone can use. We are humbled that others would like to play our music, and we hope the sheet music is of help, whether at home, in church or elsewhere.

What’s included

This package includes the bare bones: an accurate chord chart and a notated vocal lead sheet.

Format

Digital PDF, available to download after purchase.

products.name: A Child Is Born Music
products.short_description:
Over the years we’ve had quite a few requests for sheet music for our songs, which we’ve sadly never been able to fulfil as we always arrange collaboratively and almost never write anything
down. However, we’ve now started the process of writing songs down in a format that we hope everyone can use. We are humbled that others would like to play our music, and we hope the sheet music is of help, whether at home, church or elsewhere.

There are 2 packages available for each song:

• Package 1 includes the bare bones: an accurate chord chart and notated vocal lead sheet.

• Package 2 includes all that plus a full score lead sheet and instrument parts. These give greater detail on what the melody instruments are doing for those who’d like to play some of the specific ‘Celtic Worship’ features of the song. There are parts for fiddle, whistle, and everything else needed depending on the song. We’ve included all the essential components of an arrangement whilst leaving room for performers to make their own mark as well.
